scientific_integrity: Analytical proof given; finite checks are corroboration and are not claimed as general proof. Literature comparison acknowledges classical matrix theory and residual originality uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple trees, counting-measure weighted-conductance heat flow, real signals, positive independent variation weights; no vertex masses, cycles, infinite graphs, nonlinear TV flow or exact fixed-time norm. Algebraic ingredients are classical and latent prior coverage remains possible.
title: Perron-optimal variation gauges and branching rigidity for heat flow on finite trees
